title: Retain display-only test location for a validated one-call command
outcome: An executed supported one-call command with a validated absolute directory can display its location when opening attribution is withheld, even without a separate runtime cwd. Display does not add proof or credit.
acceptance: An executed one-call command reports the validated local directory in test history under a withheld opening.
The stored proof worktree and claim and source authority remain empty.
